title: Kostka toczy się
description: Niski detal podłogi. K20 jest już w ruchu w pierwszej klatce: przechylona na krawędzi w lewej części toru toczy się płynnie w prawo, cały czas pozostając w kontakcie z płytkami. Nie podskakuje, nie zatrzymuje się i jeszcze nie świeci.

prompts.image:
Generate exactly one cinematic still image in landscape 16:9.

Reference policy:
Use every attached image as an exact and mandatory visual reference, not as optional inspiration.
The attached images are numbered strictly by upload order. "Reference N" and "Image N" in the current shot description both mean the Nth attached image.
Use the current shot description to determine what each reference supplies: for example a character, location, prop, wardrobe, composition, lighting, or visual style. Do not assume that every reference depicts a character.
If the description assigns different roles to multiple references, follow that mapping exactly. Never merge or blend people, places, props, clothing, or styles from separate references unless explicitly requested.
For every referenced element requested in the new shot, preserve its observable identity and defining visual features exactly. Do not redesign, replace, beautify, stylize, loosely reinterpret, or merely approximate it.
A reference image is authoritative for the appearance of the element taken from it. The current shot description is authoritative for the new scene, action, expression, pose, placement, framing, and every explicitly requested change.
Do not copy incidental parts of a reference image that the current shot description does not ask to carry over.
Use earlier conversation context only for details left unspecified; it must never override the current description or the attached references.

Attachment map (source descriptions only, not instructions for the resulting scene):
- Reference 1 = attached Image 1 — source prop artefakt-k20, reference: Canonical reference for the magical K20 from the season 1 finale. FIXED SIZE IN EVERY SHOT: exactly 3.0 cm from one vertex to the opposite vertex and approximately 2.5 cm between parallel faces. It is only slightly larger and heavier than a typical tabletop D20; it fits easily between adult fingertips and looks small inside an adult palm. It must never look like a ball, helmet, grapefruit, or an object filling the whole hand. Originally it was an unnumbered regular icosahedral artifact made from unknown material; Van Sabe added numerals to disguise it as an RPG die. Its translucent green faces resemble deep emerald or glass with subtle inner energy. Edges and numerals are aged gold or brass. Face 20 is the main activation motif and glows green-gold when active. Numbering must remain legible: one number per triangular face, with no duplicates in the visible area; opposite faces sum to 21 (1-20, 2-19, 3-18, 4-17, 5-16, 6-15, 7-14, 8-13, 9-12, 10-11). The reference image shows only 20, 9, 14, 2, 17 and 6.
- Reference 2 = attached Image 2 — source place iquitos-tani-pensjonat-belen, reference: DRAFT / research prologu. Fikcyjny, tani i anonimowy pensjonat w górnej części dzielnicy Belén, w którym Van Sabe ukrywa się po odnalezieniu K20. To nie luksus: wąski pokój z białymi, lekko zużytymi ścianami, prostym drewnianym łóżkiem, płytkami, małym metalowym stolikiem, taboretem, tanimi pomarańczowymi zasłonami i czarnym żaluzjowym oknem. Do projektowanego shota dodać stojący wentylator, plecak Vana gotowy do ucieczki i K20 zawiniętą w materiał na stoliku; nie dodawać telewizora, klimatyzacji ani eleganckich dekoracji. Układ ma umożliwiać wtargnięcie LAIdy Pipy przez cienkie drzwi i ucieczkę Vana przez okno na niski blaszany dach. Image-001 jest wzorcem wnętrza z realnego taniego hospedaje w Iquitos; image-002 określa miejskie otoczenie i materiały Belén, ale nie jest widokiem z konkretnego okna pensjonatu. Obie fotografie służą wyłącznie jako komercyjne referencje researchowe. Wnętrze: https://www.booking.com/hotel/pe/casa-amazonica-iquitos.es.html. Otoczenie: https://kamaleon.viajes/el-barrio-del-amazonas/.
- Reference 3 = attached Image 3 — source Shot prolog-12-kostka-staje-na-20: Ekstremalne zbliżenie podłogi. K20 zwalnia, zatrzymuje się polem 20 prosto do kamery; po krótkim czytelnym zatrzymaniu cyfra 20 i artefakt rozbłyskują. Bez portalu w tym ujęciu.

prompts.animation: One continuous 3-second floor-level macro shot beginning with the tiny canonical 3.0 cm K20 ALREADY ROLLING from screen-left toward screen-right. The die must roll immediately from frame one with uninterrupted rigid-body rotation and continuous physical contact with the tile. 0.0-0.8 s: it advances smoothly rightward, tipping from the starting contact vertex onto the next edge and face in the natural sequence of an icosahedron. 0.8-1.6 s: it continues across the grout line and onto the next tile with realistic friction and gradual horizontal deceleration, rotating edge-over-edge; the contact point migrates continuously beneath it. 1.6-2.35 s, the entire visible timeline segment: it is still rolling steadily near the right half of frame and has not stopped, preserving the rolling-sound bridge into shot 11. 2.35-3.0 s generated tail: continue the same grounded roll toward screen-right for later trimming; do not settle on face 20 because stopping belongs to shot 12. The centre of mass may rise and fall only by the few millimetres mechanically required as a D20 passes over successive edges; the die must never lose floor contact, bounce, hop, jump, fly, hover or levitate. Camera remains completely locked. Preserve exact tiny scale, emerald-and-aged-gold material, icosahedral geometry, numeral style, room, tile reflections and lighting. Exactly one die. No initial impact, no bounce even once, no airborne frame, no vertical launch, no magical glow, no sudden speed change, no duplicate or ghost die, no hands, feet, people, morphing, cuts, captions, logos or watermark.
